# EZ Rate Sheet

> The private lender platform that combines deal pricing, term sheets, CRM, and marketing automation in one system.

## About

EZ Rate Sheet (EZRS) is a SaaS platform built specifically for private and hard money lenders. It replaces disconnected spreadsheets, manual rate sheets, and fragmented CRMs with a single integrated system. Lenders use EZRS to capture borrower deals, calculate loan pricing automatically, generate branded term sheets, collect e-signatures, and manage their entire lending pipeline.

The platform is built and operated by Lead Engine Labs (LEL) and integrates with GoHighLevel (GHL) for CRM and marketing automation capabilities via the RiseHub partnership.

## Core Features

- Automated loan pricing engine (Fix & Flip, Bridge, Ground-Up Construction, DSCR)
- Branded borrower survey forms (embeddable on lender websites)
- Term sheet generation with e-signature via Zoho Sign
- Deal pipeline management and tracking
- Quick Term Sheet tool for experienced lenders
- Lending Network for lender-to-lender deal routing
- GoHighLevel (GHL) native integration with bi-directional sync
- Webhook and REST API for custom integrations
- White-label branding for each lender organization

## Target Audience

- Private money lenders
- Hard money lenders
- Bridge lenders
- DSCR lenders
- Mortgage brokers focused on non-QM / business purpose loans
- Lending companies with 1-50 employees

## Pricing

- Starter: $89/month (5 deals/month, 1 user)
- Team: $149/month (15 deals/month, 5 users)
- Pro: $249/month (unlimited deals, unlimited users)
- All plans include a 5-day free trial, no credit card required

## Integration Services

- GHL Custom Buildout: $2,500–$3,500 setup + $79/month
- Custom Integration Assistance: custom scoping and pricing
